defs.def: the food that you eat and drink regularly 日常饮食；日常食物

ex.s: You will stick to your diet.
Diets have changed in China – and so too has its top crop.
ex.t: 中国的饮食已经改变——其首要作物也是如此。

ex.s: To introduce the diet of a special worm.
ex.t: 介绍一种特殊蠕虫的食性。

ex.s: Fat and salt are very important parts of a diet.
ex.t: 脂肪和盐是饮食中非常重要的组成部分。

ex.s: 67   (be) full of fat and salt; by   68   (eat) more fast food people will get more salt and fat than they need in their diet.
ex.t: ____（充满）脂肪和盐；通过____（吃）更多的快餐，人们摄入的盐和脂肪将超过饮食所需。

ex.s: Nobody is quite sure, but poor diet and above all long-time alcoholism have much to do with it.
ex.t: 没有人完全确定，但不良饮食尤其是长期酗酒与此有很大关系。

ex.s: Let them be your only diet, drink and botanical medicines.
ex.t: 让它们成为你唯一的饮食、饮品和植物性药物。

defs.def: a limited variety or amount of food that you eat for medical reasons or because you want to lose weight; a time when you only eat this limited variety or amount 规定饮食（为健康或减肥等目的）；规定饮食的时期

ex.s: Make diet decisions on their own.
It is recently reported that the number of those sticking to a traditional diet is slowly declining and around half of Britain’s consumers would like to change or improve their cooking in some way.
ex.t: 最近有报道称，坚持传统饮食的人数正在缓慢下降，大约一半的英国消费者希望以某种方式改变或改进自己的烹饪。

ex.s: But using machine learning and artificial intelligence, some scientists propose that human diets consist of at least 26,000 biochemicals—and that the vast majority are not known.This shows that we have some way to travel before achieving the first objective of systems t hinking - which,in this example, is to identify more constituent parts of the nutrition system.
ex.t: 但利用机器学习和人工智能，一些科学家提出人类饮食至少包含26000种生化物质——其中绝大多数尚未被发现。这表明我们在实现系统思维的第一个目标方面还有很长的路要走——在本例中，这个目标是识别营养系统的更多组成部分。

ex.s: It will also give you suggestions on a healthier diet and how to sleep better.
ex.t: 它还会为你提供关于更健康饮食和如何改善睡眠的建议。

ex.s: Ordering food Paying the bill There is much debate nowadays as to what makes up a healthy diet.
ex.t: 点餐 付账 如今，关于什么构成健康饮食存在很多争论。

ex.s: My anxiety drove me to try every means possible to lose weight, including dieting and weight-loss pills, but this brought me nothing but pain and poor health.
ex.t: 我的焦虑驱使我尝试一切可能的减肥方法，包括节食和减肥药，但这一切带给我只有痛苦和不健康的身体。

ex.s: I worried about my weight and tried every new diet I read about online.
ex.t: 我担心自己的体重，尝试了网上读到的每一种新节食方法。

defs.def: a large amount of a restricted range of activities 大量单调的活动；大量单一的东西
